registry.identity_role: Original district sampling coordinates remain unchanged extraction anchors.

edge_padding.basis: One full officially documented meteorological spacing is added on every edge so an output coordinate beyond each administrative edge can be requested without assuming grid origin or snapping.

PRECTOTCORR.name: Precipitation Corrected
PRECTOTCORR.definition: Average MERRA-2 bias-corrected total precipitation at the surface.

T2M_MIN.name: Temperature at 2 Meters Minimum
T2M_MIN.definition: Minimum hourly air temperature at 2 meters in the daily period.

T2M_MAX.name: Temperature at 2 Meters Maximum
T2M_MAX.definition: Maximum hourly air temperature at 2 meters in the daily period.

live_minimum_bbox_span_degrees.evidence: A 2026-11-13 live 422 response rejected the initial 0.7 by 0.8 degree smoke box and required at least a 2 degree range in both latitude and longitude; the raw error body is preserved.

regional_contract.large_region_guidance: The v2.10.3 OpenAPI description recommends NETCDF for large regions.
regional_contract.usage_guidance: Avoid excessive synchronous requests and do not request more finely than current source resolution.

region_partitioning.reason: A single area avoids overlapping tile edges and undocumented grid snapping. The published schema has no numeric maximum bbox span; annual national JSON succeeded in the preflight; full collection is separately authorized in Step 3D.

smoke_test.bbox_basis: The minimum 2 by 2 degree span required by a preserved live 422 response, positioned over central Bangladesh and containing the unchanged Dhaka registry point. It is an API/parser test area, not a new district sampling coordinate or national partition.
smoke_test.multi_parameter_probe: Optional diagnostic runs first. A 422 rejection permits the four single-parameter requests; an unexpected 200 counts toward the cap and stops the smoke test before further data requests.

network_policy.retry_after: Honor Retry-After delta-seconds or HTTP-date when present.

storage.raw_policy: Preserve exact response bytes; atomically publish only structurally verified responses.

identity_and_extraction.adoption: Saim explicitly adopted representative-point context on 2026-11-13; independent scientific review remains pending.
identities: Original district sampling coordinates are unchanged WGS84 anchors from the Step 1 registry.
Regional output coordinates are API-returned GeoJSON positions and are stored exactly as returned.
Native source-grid identity is not assigned; returned nodes are not claimed to be unique native cells.
identity_and_extraction.proposed_method: After exact cross-parameter coordinate/date alignment, use the user-adopted nearest returned output coordinate to each original district point using great-circle distance; record both coordinates, distance and deterministic distance/latitude/longitude tie-breaking.
identity_and_extraction.contract_change: Yes. This would replace a point-API request at each district anchor with nearest-returned-node extraction. The registry points remain unchanged, but the scientific sampling method requires review.
identity_and_extraction.edge_rule: Use the padded area; expose actual distances without an invented cutoff. Fail if an adopted coordinate is absent in a later verified regional view. No district-area or field measurement is claimed.
